entry.title: How To Manage Dangerous Actions In User Interfaces
entry.summary: One of the main laws that applies to almost everything in our lives, including building digital products, is Murphy’s Law: “Anything that can go wrong will go wrong.” Our goal is to prevent things from going wrong and, if they do, mitigate the consequences.
